source:
if test "$#" -ne 3; then
    printf 'Usage: configure preview-or-apply LEVEL FORMAT\n' >&2
    exit 2
fi
mode=$1
level=$2
format=$3
case "$mode" in preview|apply) : ;; *) printf 'Usage: configure preview-or-apply LEVEL FORMAT\n' >&2; exit 2 ;; esac
case "$level" in error|info|debug) : ;; *) printf 'Invalid level\n' >&2; exit 2 ;; esac
case "$format" in text|json) : ;; *) printf 'Invalid format\n' >&2; exit 2 ;; esac
if test -f service.conf; then :; else printf 'Missing configuration\n' >&2; exit 2; fi
# A non-newline marker prevents command capture from deleting final newlines.
before=$(cat service.conf; printf '.')
body=''
# This is the specifically supported empty-IFS read idiom, not default read.
# The redirected loop runs in the caller, so body survives the loop.
while IFS= read -r line || test -n "$line"; do
    case "$line" in
        log_level=*|format=*) : ;;
        *) body=$body$line'
' ;;
    esac
done < service.conf
candidate=$body'log_level='$level'
format='$format'
'
if test "$before" = "${candidate}."; then
    printf 'Unchanged\n'
    exit 0
fi
if test "$mode" = preview; then
    printf 'Would update\n%s' "$candidate"
else
    printf '%s' "$candidate" > service.conf
    printf 'Updated\n'
fi

if test -f service.conf; then :; else printf 'Missing configuration\n' >&2; exit 2; fi
# A non-newline marker prevents command capture from deleting final newlines.
before=$(cat service.conf; printf '.')
prefix=$(grep -E -v '^(log_level|format)=' service.conf; printf '.')
candidate=${prefix%.}'log_level='$level'
format='$format'
'

fi
if test "$mode" = preview; then

else
    printf '%s' "$candidate" > service.conf
    printf 'Updated\n'
fi

cases.name: Collapse duplicates while preserving operator lines

files./work/service.conf:
# local site
log_level=error
  keep padded  

format=text
log_level=debug

after./work/service.conf:
# local site
  keep padded  

log_level=info
format=json

files./work/service.conf:

# price 100% $HOME * \ literal
	 keep this final row

after./work/service.conf:
# price 100% $HOME * \ literal
	 keep this final row

format=json

example_source:
# Apply twice in this Run. A new Run starts with its own sample files.
configure_report() {
    style=$1
    layout=$2
    before=$(cat report.conf; printf '.')
    body=''
    while IFS= read -r line || test -n "$line"; do
        case "$line" in
            style=*|layout=*) : ;;
            *) body=$body$line'
' ;;
        esac
    done < report.conf
    candidate=$body'style='$style'
layout='$layout'
'
    if test "$before" = "${candidate}."; then
        printf 'Unchanged\n'
    else
        printf '%s' "$candidate" > report.conf
        printf 'Updated\n'
    fi
}
configure_report compact columns
configure_report compact columns

example_case.name: Apply report settings twice in one separate example run

files./work/report.conf:
# weekly report
  retain this spacing  
style=verbose
layout=plain
style=old

after./work/report.conf:
# weekly report
  retain this spacing  
style=compact
layout=columns
